slides.title: Log in with the first-admin code
slides.html: Open your Deploy App address. Type the first-admin code from your service operator in Enter your code and press Login with Code.

slides.title: Choose your callsign
slides.html:
Type a callsign your unit knows you by and press Continue.

  • You use the same callsign in every service.
  • It is also your certificate password.
  • As the first admin you skip the waiting room.

slides.title: Get your key
slides.html: Press Download key. The key is a file you install on this computer.

slides.title: Install the key
slides.html:
Open the file from your browser's downloads in the top-right corner. In the Certificate Import Wizard:

  1. Press Next twice.
  2. Enter your callsign as the password.
  3. Press Next twice, then Finish and OK.

Back in the browser, press Installed – continue.

  • On Firefox, Deploy App shows one more step for adding the key to Firefox.

slides.title: Go to the service
slides.html: Press Go to the service. When the browser asks for a certificate, select your callsign and press OK.

slides.title: You're in
slides.html:
Deploy App opens with the admin tools. A short guide shows the first time. Press Next to go through it, or close it.

  • Next, add your users. See Adding Users.
